tb21_profile.skill: Parse HTML robustly and remove the complete JavaScript attack surface - script elements, on* handlers, javascript:/data: URLs, srcdoc, style expressions, comment and encoding tricks - while leaving every other byte of the document functionally intact
tb21_profile.domain: Web security / XSS; Python HTML parsing (html.parser, lxml, BeautifulSoup, bleach) and serialisation
tb21_profile.task_form: Implement-from-spec: a CLI script editing a file in place, graded on an adversarial corpus of payloads plus benign documents that must survive unchanged

verifier_notes: task_000174_0212094d (TMax) asks for a bit-exact C reimplementation of a binary that sanitises XSS/SQLi payloads - on skill it would rank near the top, but it is graded FREE and is excluded entirely. tw_12702 (parse HTML, emit body text only) is TerminalWorld's best HTML-parsing task and is FREE; ranked 2nd in per_source, not in final_top10. security_20260617_210354_001 (CalibForge filter bypass) is likewise FREE and kept to per_source. task_000588_bcb24536 (CLEAN/EVIL XSS classifier) is FREE and was dropped. Terminal-Lego grades used here (task_06939 ok, task_07072 weak, task_06389 weak) look low relative to content: these corpora run many small assertions and the heuristic dilutes strength, but none is FREE so the hard rule is satisfied.

notes: Both new corpora beat the v1 pool here. CalibForge's security_20260430_081156_003 is almost the same task written for YAML (identical in-place / preserve-formatting wording) and its security_20260509_202829_001 is the attacker's half of this exact problem; Terminal-Lego, as the spec predicted, is genuinely strong on HTML sanitising (task_06939, task_07072, task_06389, task_03040, task_06168) and contributes three of the final ten. SWE-Smith is unusually useful for this TB2.1 task because markupsafe, python-readability, mistune, soupsieve and dominate are precisely the HTML-escaping and HTML-cleaning libraries involved; their repo-tests grade makes them trustworthy. Recursive-Task-Synthesis has nothing defensible - its HTML entries are CV-to-PDF conversions and web-server setup, so ranks 5-10 there are filler. SWE-Rebench is likewise thin: Jinja and WeasyPrint share the ecosystem but not the skill.
